ranking.name: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel New Orleans

text.text_excerpt: Stayed here a few times (2 or 3 day weekends) and love the hotel. I'm a budget traveler and it is nice to stay in what I consider a 4 star hotel at their very inexpensive weekend getaway prices. Also, because you are across Canal from the French Quarters, I like free weekend parking on the street. Room is always comfortable and nice, the staff friendly and helpful, and it is a great location being two long blocks from the river and train, a couple of blocks from the St. Charles trolly and the French Quarters is just across the street. The only thing I don't like is that Harrah's is right next door. I've won money two out of three times I've been in there. But the thought of being near a C...

Excellent location- short walk to French Quarter. We were able to experience 2 fun parades within 1-2 blocks from the hotel as the routes ended near the hotel. It was approx a 10-minute walk to Jackson Square. The beds were comfy but the pillows were awful, even with piling up 3 on top of each other. Lobby was beautifully decorated with Xmas decor. The hotel room had a modern feel, great big tv and ice machines on every floor. We enjoyed the delicious signature warm chocolate chip nut cookies they give to guests. Rooms and bathrooms aren't that spacious but we made it work. My kids loved the 4th floor swimming pool. Be prepared to pay high parking fees; we paid $45/night as overnight gues...

We AGONIZED over which hotel to choose for our visit in New Orleans. Essentially every hotel has both good and bad reviews. I tend to like the DoubleTree brand and the overall price, reviews, and location so we rolled the dice and booked a room for our four night stay here. Arrival: we arrived on a late flight after midnight. Fortunately, there was one staff member in the lobby who directed us to the only entrance at that hour which is locked. There was no aggressively warm welcome but we were checked in quickly and provided with info for the cleaning schedule. Room: I was upgraded to the junior suite and it was MASSIVE.
